channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Bessent Faces Credibility Test in Quest to Tame Markets
item.description: The Treasury secretary is confronting the limits of his ability to reshape the economy ahead of midterm elections.

item.title: NPR: COMIC: 7 lifestyle habits that may boost your chances of getting pregnant
item.description: This illustrated guide has evidence-backed advice on how to support fertility for both men and women, including which foods to eat and which activities to avoid.

item.title: BBC News: Watch: The life of an iconic country singer
item.description: Iconic country musician Dolly Parton has died at the age of 80, the singer's team announced on social media.

item.title: Al Jazeera: One US dollar now costs 2 million rials in Iran, and here’s what it can buy
item.description: Sanctions and the US-Israel war on Iran have left the country's people unable to keep pace with rising prices.

item.title: Ars Technica: The world's busiest spaceport is about to get a lot quieter, at least for now
item.description: SpaceX aims to launch Starship from Florida by the end of the year. 2027 seems more likely.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: How Teen ‘After-Prom’ Kings in LA Monetized the High School Rager
item.description: The West Coast house-party scene has long been iconic. For these young, tech-savvy entrepreneurs, it was also inspiration for MyPlots, a party-promotion empire.

item.title: WIRED Science: A Mutation Is Making It Easier for Drug-Resistant Malaria to Spread
item.description: New findings shed light on what’s making the parasite less treatable using the drug that’s considered a first line of defense.

item.title: WIRED Business: It Should Be Harder to Apply for a Job. No, Really
item.description: Thanks to a dwindling supply of open roles, “one-click” applications, and the rise of artificial intelligence, it’s easier than ever to apply for a job. We’re all paying the price.

item.title: The New Yorker: Adam Hamilton and Taking Back Religion from the Right
item.description: Democratic socialists are getting more of the attention, but Democratic Christians may prove more influential this November.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Your Daily Horoscope by Madame Clairevoyant: August 26, 2026
item.description: You might find your plans waylaid today as tension arises between the sun, Pluto, and Neptune.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Donna Karan Is Embroiled in a Rat Face-off
item.description: After the designer sued Neil Bender’s real-estate firm, claiming its empty lot next door brought rats into her store, the developer has countersued.
